inputContract.My_profile: Compose: server-loaded profile; owner-only construction. App-supplied item ID is a reference, not authorization.

profileShape.accountId: canonical Person Claims from stored profile, never app email
profileShape.displayName: stored Person DisplayName for owner preview
profileShape.status: validation Status choice Value; participation status is separate pending #6
profileShape.teachIds: array of integer Language catalogue IDs
profileShape.learnIds: array of integer Language catalogue IDs
profileShape.shareCultureIds: array of integer Culture catalogue IDs
profileShape.learnCultureIds: array of integer Culture catalogue IDs

inputs.where: @and(   equals(outputs('My_profile')?['status'], 'Active'),   not(empty(outputs('My_profile')?['accountId'])),   equals(item()?['status'], 'Active'),   not(empty(item()?['accountId'])),   not(equals(item()?['accountId'], outputs('My_profile')?['accountId'])),   or(     not(empty(intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['learnIds'], item()?['teachIds']))),     not(empty(intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['teachIds'], item()?['learnIds']))),     not(empty(intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['learnCultureIds'], item()?['shareCultureIds']))),     not(empty(intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['shareCultureIds'], item()?['learnCultureIds'])))   ) )

select.fitType: @if(   empty(union(     intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['learnIds'], item()?['teachIds']),     intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['teachIds'], item()?['learnIds'])   )),   'Culture',   if(     empty(union(       intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['learnCultureIds'], item()?['shareCultureIds']),       intersection(outputs('My_profile')?['shareCultureIds'], item()?['learnCultureIds'])     )),     'Language',     'Combined'   ) )
